name: Recurly
summary: Recurly's Starter plan costs $249 a month plus 0.9% of billing volume above the first $40,000 each month, with a 90-day free trial. All-Access, which adds the MRR dashboard, intelligent retries and single sign-on, needs at least $1 million in billing volume.

facts.text: The MRR dashboard is not included in Starter, while the churn benchmarks dashboard is on every plan.
Account Updater is not included in Starter and costs extra.
When a merchant leaves, Recurly provides one free export of card data in tokenized form to a PCI-compliant system.
Built-in sales tax calculation, powered by Avalara, is available on all plans.
The Starter terms renew for one-year terms unless either side gives notice at least 30 days before renewal.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Plus 0.9% of billing volume above the first $40,000 each month; 1 dunning campaign

plans.name: All-Access
plans.notes: Billed annually; $1 million billing volume minimum, quoted as under 1% of volume

hiddenCosts: Engage starts at $1,600 a month and RevRec at $850 a month, billed annually.
Payment gateway fees are paid separately.

contract.cancellation: Renews for one-year terms unless notice is given 30 days before renewal; fees are non-refundable.
contract.dataExport: Billing data exports from Analytics, and one free tokenized card export when leaving.
